name: fore-the-record
description: Fore the Record is a web application for recording golf rounds and tracking a player's World Handicap System (WHS) Handicap Index over time. Users will be able to create a profile, find golf courses and tees, enter scorecards and playing conditions, and review which rounds contribute to their current handicap.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:deployment
